text.p: Headlines from major national newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
EL PAIS
- 37 years' prison for (Basque separatist) ETA members who tried to kill King Juan Carlos in Mallorca
- Spy microphone found in (Prisa group chairman) Jesus de Polanco's office
- France assumes deficit will be more than three percent despite tough cuts
- Supreme court overules accusation by (governing) Popular Party in Filesa (illegal political party financing) case
EL MUNDO
- Democratic parties join (Basque separatists) Herri Batasuna in village of ETA prisoner after his suicide
- (Basque separatist guerrilla) ETA responds to popular uprising by throwing granades at Oviedo centre
DIARIO 16
- ETA Misfire
ABC
- (Prime Minister) Aznar tells Ermua town: "Hold on; you are a symbol for society"
CINCO DIAS
- Megabanks: Bayerishe Veriensbank and Hipobank create Germany's second biggest bank
- Jospin raises corporate tax 5.5 points to square up deficit
- Stock market sheds 4.5 percent in three sessions
EXPANSION
- Government speeds up privatisation of Iberia, will place 50 percent on stock market in 1998
- France raises corporate tax to get into euro
- Savings banks' association CECA recognises that savings banks don't have size to compete in Europe
GACETA DE LOS NEGOCIOS
- Endesa to sell 25 percent of its capital to retail investors in an unstable stock market
- Companies to bear brunt of adjustment designed by Jospin
